name: notifications
title: Notifications (inbox, push, email)
description: One call, every channel: ctx.notify(user, 'order-shipped', { order }) writes the in-app inbox, sends a push and an email, following each user's preferences and quiet hours. Types are small files in app/notifications/.
docs:
Send: await ctx.notify(userId, 'welcome', { name }) (types live in app/notifications/<type>.js), or ctx.notify(userId, { title, body, url }).
Inbox: GET /api/notifications, GET /api/notifications/unread-count, POST /api/notifications/:id/read, POST /api/notifications/read-all.
Preferences: GET and PATCH /api/notifications/preferences (channels per type, quiet hours). The GET lists every type, so a settings screen can be built from it.
Push needs devices (POST /api/auth/devices); in development, simulated devices in devtools show it on a lock screen.
